serena: Heads up — support flagged a tenant (nova-labs) seeing recurring negative preview adjustments in the hourly invoice-preview card. Preview drops ~4-6% at 00:00 boundary, ledger unaffected.

omar: Negative adjustments meaning preview shows less tokens than streaming tally? Any sample traces?

serena: Yes. Preview shows tokens=98,400 for 23:00-00:00 but when finalizing for 00:00 it emits an adjustment -5,200 and the console shows final preview 93,200. Ledger still records 98,400.

li: That smells like window-trimming: aggregator watermark is dropping late-arriving events, but preview pipeline is applying a trim at finalization and tagging them as adjustments rather than holding them for the next window. Why ledger isn't affected? ledger uses ingest_time and a 2h lateness allowance. Preview uses event_ts and a tight 30s watermark for low-latency counters.

frank: Can you paste a raw event that got trimmed?

serena: here's one from the preview topic (redacted):
```
{
  "req_id":"req-9988",
  "tenant":"nova-labs",
  "tokens":512,
  "event_ts":"2026-03-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "ingest_time":"2026-03-15T00:00:01.250Z",
  "source":"edge-proxy-7"
}
```

li: Ah! event_ts is exactly at 00:00:00 but edge proxies stamp event_ts using client-supplied timestamp (x-client-ts) if present. Several mobile SDKs in nova-labs were sending slightly old client timestamps (NTP skew -1s). Aggregator uses event_ts to decide window membership; because our watermark policy treats anything <= window_end - 1ms as final for that window, small negative skew pushes events into previous window which has been finalized, so preview emits an out-of-window adjustment. Ledger uses ingest_time and grace so it gets included in the correct window.

omar: So root cause: client-supplied timestamps + tight watermarking in preview aggregator. Two options: (A) prefer ingest_time for windowing in preview pipeline; (B) canonicalize client-supplied event_ts but bound it to ingest_time +/- 250ms; (C) widen watermark grace in preview to 2s.

frank: Widening watermark to 2s increases preview latency. We built the 30s tight watermark to keep preview near real-time. But 2s might be acceptable. Prefer deterministic fix: sanitize event_ts at ingress to clamp within [ingest_time - 500ms, ingest_time + 50ms], then keep windowing on event_ts. That preserves low latency while avoiding tiny negative skews.

li: Also recommend adding metric ingest.event_ts_skew_ms (histogram) and an alert when p99 > 500ms for any tenant over 10m. Would have caught this earlier.

serena: I queried preview adjustments and found ~6.4k adjustment events for nova-labs between 23:50-00:10 yesterday. They correlate with proxy-7 which had client sdk rollback.

omar: Owners: @frank - implement event_ts clamp in proxy (ingest side) and propagate X-EVENT-TS-ORIGINAL; @li - add skew metric + alert and update aggregator watermark config to 2s for preview clusters as short-term safety; @serena - run a backfill to recompute preview totals for the affected windows and emit reconciled rows with a reconciliation flag for console.

metering-bot: deploy-canary: proxy-ingest v5.2 -> v5.3 started by frank at 6958882245

support-bot: Support note draft: "We observed preview adjustments due to client timestamp skew during a short window; invoices (ledger) are unaffected. We will reconcile preview history and surface corrected totals; if you saw unexpected preview changes we can provide tenant-level diffs."

frank: Canary looks fine for 8m on canary-02. The clamp sets event_ts = min(event_ts, ingest_time + 50ms) and max(event_ts, ingest_time - 500ms). I also preserved original in header.

li: I pushed the skew metric and a dashboard card. Alert rule: p99(skew_ms) > 500 for 10m -> page oncall.

serena: Starting backfill job now to recompute preview totals for 23:45-00:15 window for affected tenants. I'll emit reconciliation_summary when done.

omar: Good. Also add a small console UX note: mark reconciled preview snapshots with a yellow "reconciled" pill and link to support blurb. Prevents confusion if users see historical corrections.

serena: Will add UI note in changelog. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
